journey.title: Cooking and logging
journey.purpose: Start cooking from Today, follow one pinned revision step by step with explicit completion and durable timers, then finish with batch confirmation and, separately, a recorded serving.

steps.intent: Start cooking the selected meal in one action.
Read the current step and mark it done explicitly.
Start a step timer and leave the screen while it runs.
Return to an elapsed timer that did not complete the step.
Finish by confirming the batch and, separately, recording a serving eaten.

claims.statement: A person can cook without logging, eat leftovers without cooking again, or exit without recording anything.
Undo creates a correction and reverses linked inventory effects exactly once.
